causal_mechanism: The canonical general checkpoint verifier allows append-only scope growth for its other operations. The certificate wrapper restricted certificate responsibility but did not restrict the candidate document catalog or baselines.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: A certificate-only candidate retains the exact current obligation catalog and baseline history.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Compare those arrays structurally with the authoritative graph before calling the existing general bound verifier; scope amendments use their separate reconciliation path.

applicability_conditions: A general verifier serves both scope reconciliation and narrower certificate publication.
known_non_matches: Authorized scope reconciliation retains its own general checkpoint contract.
